DEATHBRINGER.content:
This build makes trade-offs to maximize single-target damage, at the expense of cleave and AoE damage. On any fight with adds, swap  Runic Overflow/ Icy Onslaught/ Frigid Executioner out for  Frostscythe/ Biting Cold/ Gathering Storm.
